identity.name: Pelagos
identity.one_liner: Tudor's standard 42mm titanium dive tool watch, in production since 2012 with a matte black dial, snowflake hands, and a helium escape valve.

narrative.story: The Pelagos launched in 2012 as Tudor's dedicated dive-tool watch, separate from the vintage-styled Black Bay line: titanium case, matte ceramic-insert bezel, and a rubber strap with a spring-loaded extension link for use over a wetsuit. Tudor later moved the line to its in-house MT5612 chronometer movement without changing the reference number.
narrative.collector_notes: Buyers checking a used listing should confirm whether the movement is the original ETA-based caliber or the later in-house MT5612, since both were sold under the same 25600TN reference and only the caseback or a service record reliably distinguishes them.
